title: Harmony Fifth meeting

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Did that rain feel weird for you yesterday?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did that rain feel weird for you yesterday?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No more than usual.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No more than usual.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: A little.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: A little.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: I'd almost describe it as spongy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'd almost describe it as spongy.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: What do you think it could be?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you think it could be?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: What do you think it could be?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: What do you think it could be?

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: I'm no rainologist, but if I were to guess, CorpSec are probably putting something in it to keep us calm.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm no rainologist, but if I were to guess, CorpSec are probably putting something in it to keep us calm.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you feel calm?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you feel calm?

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: No, not really, but it's CorpSec. They'd manage to screw it up somehow.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No, not really, but it's CorpSec. They'd manage to screw it up somehow.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: They're doing their best.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They're doing their best.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Very true.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Very true.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: I've been thinking a lot about that poverty positivity stuff. I think it's a crock of rat meat. Which is ironically all I can afford to eat.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I've been thinking a lot about that poverty positivity stuff. I think it's a crock of rat meat. Which is ironically all I can afford to eat.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I thought business was booming in the LUZ.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I thought business was booming in the LUZ.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I thought business was booming in the LUZ.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I thought business was booming in the LUZ.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: That's exactly the problem. Didn't take long for the Corpsters to pick up on the fact us little people were turning a profit.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's exactly the problem. Didn't take long for the Corpsters to pick up on the fact us little people were turning a profit.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Makes good financial sense.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Makes good financial sense.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Greedy Corpster cockroaches.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Greedy Corpster cockroaches.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Yeah, sure it does if you're at the top of the Vinc tube defecating on everyone else. Fuck everyone else though, right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, sure it does if you're at the top of the Vinc tube defecating on everyone else. Fuck everyone else though, right?

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: I'm sure it seems like a sweet deal if you're at the top of the Vinc tube defecating on everyone else. Fuck everyone else though right?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm sure it seems like a sweet deal if you're at the top of the Vinc tube defecating on everyone else. Fuck everyone else though right?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's the way this city seems to be coded.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's the way this city seems to be coded.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's the way this city seems to be coded.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's the way this city seems to be coded.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Well they'll see when there's nobody left here to sell to because we either all die of hunger or get murdered by the Aseptic.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well they'll see when there's nobody left here to sell to because we either all die of hunger or get murdered by the Aseptic.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: That's a pretty grim outlook.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's a pretty grim outlook.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Well you never know, some of us might be lucky enough to freeze to death! Want some Goulash? I've discovered this old recipe recently and can't get enough of it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well you never know, some of us might be lucky enough to freeze to death! Want some Goulash? I've discovered this old recipe recently and can't get enough of it.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Did it work on you?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Did it work on you?

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: They've slapped taxes on all goods entering the LUZ. I'm barely breaking even.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They've slapped taxes on all goods entering the LUZ. I'm barely breaking even.

nodes.speaker: Harmony
nodes.text: Well they'll see when there's nobody left here to sell to because we all died of hunger in the LUZ.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Well they'll see when there's nobody left here to sell to because we all died of hunger in the LUZ.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: They make more money if they let us live.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: They make more money if they let us live.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: They make more money if they let us live.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: They make more money if they let us live.
